review_evidence: The RMT4 source is a complex-analysis formalization: RMT4/Main.lean proves a Riemann-mapping theorem statement by constructing an injective holomorphic map onto the unit disk.

RMT4/defs.lean defines the good-domain and embedding interfaces and supporting lemmas used by the main proof, while the remaining modules cover Montel, Hurwitz, square roots, compactness, and upstreamable lemmas.
All current-primary Lean files belong to that mathematical development or its supporting interfaces; no content-level lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the complete RMT4 complex-analysis formalization and its supporting lemmas.
